about: A writer drafts a note on what a password manager is. The evaluator counts the words with a tool, asks for a revision, and accepts the second draft. Both agents run on Gemini, free tier.
how: The evaluator answers with a verdict (accept or revise) and feedback. Before it judges, it calls the word counter (characters, words, sentences). A revise sends the draft back to the writer, up to two rounds.
learns: A loop with a clear check makes the answer better, as far as the criteria say. The evaluator counts words with a tool, because a model counts badly.
watch: The counter row before each verdict, the feedback of the first round, and what the writer changed in the second draft.
